h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Assam

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Assam

c: Parks, river-front walkways, tea estate colonies and housing societies in Assam all make good sites for an outdoor gym, and FunPlay supplies the machines for them. Every station uses the person's own body weight, so it suits walkers, students and senior citizens alike. We build our Fun Fitness range at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, and send it to Assam by road. Our own installation team or a dealer in the region fixes the stations, on a grouted or self-standing base to suit the ground.

Buyers differ from one part of the state to another. In Guwahati and Dispur they are mostly housing societies, schools and city parks. Upper Assam adds tea estates and the oil towns around Digboi and Duliajan, where company townships run their own parks and clubs. In the Barak valley, schools and colleges in Silchar often have open grounds where a row of stations can sit beside a walking track. Jorhat, Tezpur and Dibrugarh have colleges and municipal parks that follow the same pattern on a smaller scale.

richText.heading: Rain, floods and choosing the site

c: Assam gets heavy rain through the monsoon, and parts of the Brahmaputra valley flood most years. Pick the highest corner of your ground for the gym, raise the base a little and give it a slope so water runs off. Our galvanised frames handle the humidity well, and roto-moulded seats and grips do not rust.

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Do you supply outdoor gym equipment to tea estates in Assam?
items.a: Yes. Estate managers can send us the size of the ground in the staff colony and the number of people likely to use it. We suggest a set of machines and send a layout drawing before you place an order.

items.q: Will the machines rust in Assam's humid weather?
items.a: The frames are galvanised pipe and the seats and grips are roto-moulded plastic, both chosen to resist rust. Frames carry a 3-year warranty and bearings carry 1 year when the equipment is maintained as per our instructions.

items.q: How do I get a quote for a park in Assam?
items.a: Call our sales team on +91 902 830 2266 or email sales@funplaysystems.com with photos of the site, its rough size and the town. We reply with suggested machines and a layout.
